title.narrative: Institutional Support for Better Service Delivery to enhance enterprise access to markets and export.

description.narrative: The project aims to support SMEs, particularly agro-processors, to access domestic, regional and international markets for their produces. Most SMEs have not obtained certification of their products due to awareness and information gap on requirements and procedures for domestic and international trade. Moreover, produces by SMEs face stiff competition from imports, some of which are inferior, and counterfeits. The project will support the Fair Competition Commission to develop an intranet which will ease its internal processes including those related to curbing counterfeits and raising public awareness on the economic and health consequences of consuming counterfeit products. It will also improve knowledge of the SMEs on trade requirements and procedures through developing a simplified manual on the subject for quick reference by SMEs and conducting training sessions for the SMEs. The SMEs are expected to grow and graduate to higher levels with increased access to markets.
